svg.title: Open book
svg.desc: Menu “Topics & dictionary” (Nave’s topics, Easton’s dictionary); also the emoji mark “Scripture”, the “Classic” color theme, the timeline’s Bible icon, and “Kind of writing” in the Visual Bible card. Timeline “book”: items named bible, testament, vulgate, version, biblia, graece, instrumentum; lives: wycliffe, erasmus, tyndale, tischendorf, jerome; stream “The Bible in world history” (Drawn at stroke-width 1.8, 1.9, 2 in different places.)
